==Description==
The '''Slime''' is an enemy that only appears in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. Originally, this was the [[Super Slime]] enemy, though in [[v1.23.0]] the [[Super Slime]] (which was called just ''Slime'' at the time) was changed to be a different enemy called [[Super Slime|Radioactive Slime]], making this its old version. This change was made due to [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode being moved to the new mode system. As in the new mode system, modern enemies will be used over legacy enemies, an identically named modern enemy [[Slime]] would replace the [[Super Slime]] in the wave structure, and even replaced it in the [[Nuclear Monster]]'s spawn pool. The enemy remained unused after the name change, later being made available again through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode.

==Appearance==
The '''Slime''' is a large faceless humanoid with a waist in its rig. It has a green skin color and a brown torso and legs. All of its body parts are encased in translucent green slime, which constantly emits green particles.
